facts.text: The St. Regis Aspen Resort is located at the base of Aspen Mountain, close to the town and the mountain.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Aspen Resort is located at the base of Aspen Mountain and puts you in great proximity to the town and the mountain.

facts.text: The hotel is a three-minute walk from the base of Aspen Mountain, or five minutes in ski boots.
facts.excerpt: Just a three-minute walk from the base of Aspen Mountain (or five minutes, if ski boots are on)

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the St. Regis as a Gilded Age mountain manor.
facts.excerpt: the St. Regis is a Gilded Age mountain manor that would have made John Jacob Astor proud

facts.text: RAKxa Wellness Spa includes the Confluence, reminiscent of the hot springs in Colorado.
facts.excerpt: It offers 15,000 sq. ft. of space, luxurious treatments, a world-class fitness center, and the Confluence, reminiscent of the hot springs in Colorado.

facts.text: The resort has a heated outdoor pool and hot tubs that overlook Aspen Mountain.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy our heated outdoor pool and hot tubs that overlook stunning Aspen Mountain.

facts.text: The resort is a host hotel for the FOOD and WINE Classic in Aspen.
facts.excerpt: A host hotel for the FOOD and WINE Classic in Aspen

facts.text: Velvet Buck uses local, seasonal ingredients in a fusion of multiple cuisines and serves breakfast daily.
facts.excerpt: Velvet Buck utilizes local, seasonal ingredients to create an exquisite fusion of multiple cuisines and offers breakfast daily.

facts.text: Mountain Social Bar & Lounge hosts a daily champagne sabering.
facts.excerpt: Experience our daily champagne sabering or sip on a signature cocktail in our Aspen Mountain bar.

facts.text: The hotel's local take on the St. Regis Bloody Mary is the Downhill Snapper, made with dill, basil and citrus.
facts.excerpt: highlighted with dill, basil, and citrus at The St. Regis Aspen Resort

facts.text: Apres Tea in Mountain Social Bar & Lounge is inspired by Caroline Astor, with an alpine twist.
facts.excerpt: in Mountain Social Bar & Lounge to celebrate a timeless experience inspired by Caroline Astor with an alpine twist

facts.text: Private in-room dining is available 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: With private dining service available 24 hours a day

facts.text: Rooms, suites and residences have 400-thread-count Frette linens and marble bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel rooms, suites, and residences feature sumptuous 400-thread-count Frette linens, spacious marble bathrooms

facts.text: Custom furnishings are by Rottet Studio.
facts.excerpt: custom furnishings from acclaimed architect and designer, Rottet Studio

facts.text: Rooms feature mountain-inspired furnishings by Ralph Lauren.
facts.excerpt: Our Aspen Mountain luxury hotel rooms feature mountain-inspired furnishings by Ralph Lauren

facts.text: Two-bedroom suites have living space, fireplaces and kitchenettes.
facts.excerpt: Reserve a two-bedroom hotel suite in Aspen with ample living space, cozy fireplaces and kitchenettes

facts.text: For suite guests, butlers handle unpacking and packing, morning beverage service, garment pressing and shoeshine.
facts.excerpt: For our Suite guests, unpacking and packing, morning beverage service, garment pressing, and shoeshine are a few of the everyday services

facts.text: St. Regis Butler Service is available 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: St. Regis Butler Service is ready to assist you 24 hours a day.

facts.text: Ski valets help with ski and snowboard equipment and offer local knowledge of terrain and conditions.
facts.excerpt: They assist with ski and snowboard equipment as well as offer local knowledge of terrain and conditions.

facts.text: The hotel partners with the Aspen Outfitting Company for guided activities including fly fishing and clay target shooting.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Aspen partners with the Aspen Outfitting Company to provide travelers and residents with an unparalleled selection of guided activities, ranging from: Fly fishing, clay target shooting

facts.text: The Silver Circle Ice Rink is adjacent to the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The Silver Circle Ice Rink is adjacent to the hotel.

facts.text: Families can enjoy dinner by the firepits at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: dinner by the firepits at St. Regis Aspen

facts.text: The resort offers the city's largest ballroom.
facts.excerpt: our Aspen hotel resort offers the city's largest ballroom

facts.text: Aspen-Pitkin County Airport is about 3 miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: ASE is located approximately 3.0 Miles from the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel has an airport shuttle to Aspen-Pitkin County Airport.
facts.excerpt: Yes, The St. Regis Aspen Resort has an airport shuttle to Aspen-Pitkin County Airport (ASE).

facts.text: Aspen's ski and snowboard season runs from about Thanksgiving weekend to the first few weeks of April.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in Aspen skiing or snowboarding from approximately Thanksgiving weekend to the first few weeks in April.

facts.text: Four ski mountains are within reach: Snowmass, Aspen, Aspen Highlands and Buttermilk.
facts.excerpt: With four world-class mountains within reach (Snowmass, Aspen, Aspen Highlands and Buttermilk Mountain)

facts.text: The fitness center has Technogym equipment.
facts.excerpt: The Fitness Center at our Aspen ski hotel features state-of-the-art Technogym equipment.

facts.text: The hotel welcomes dogs only, and a pet fee applies.
facts.excerpt: Dogs only. Dog fee is $150/stay

facts.text: The hotel received a Forbes Travel Guide Four-Star rating in 2024.
facts.excerpt: 2024 Forbes Travel Guide Four-Star

facts.text: The hotel's spa is RAKxa Wellness Spa.
facts.excerpt: RAKxa Wellness Spa, located within our Aspen Mountain ski resort

facts.text: The hotel has a Remede spa.
facts.excerpt: A Remède spa and new Italian restaurant
